header.title: How I read you, so I could meet you where you are.
header.sub: Before we spoke, I read your public voice and tuned everything to it. This is that read, and it is why the rest of the studio lands in your register. It is also the most honest one to start with, because it names exactly how much it can and cannot see.

caveat: Resolution: low, and I will not pretend otherwise. I read your public LinkedIn, ran a web scan, and used our call. The scan confirmed there is no public corpus of talks, podcasts, or writing to tune on, unlike some reads I build. So this is grounded in your career arc, your own words on our call, and your public affiliations, and it says out loud where it is inference. A GitHub, your X (@yurikleban), or anything you write would raise it fast. Only with your OK.

voice.h2: A storyteller who taught himself to build.
voice.headline: Advertising and film, then self-taught engineer, then the person who builds the tools that brief the execs.

registers.name: The builder
registers.cues: BS in advertising and a filmmaker, then self-taught engineer at Google, then PM · internal tools that empower teams · productivity per person, $ per rep, CSAT
registers.quote: We take first party and third party data and stitch it together into briefs for execs before they meet people.

registers.name: The connector
registers.cues: growth-hacker and advisor to six-plus startups, no percentage · “please reach out if that’s you” · trilingual global bridge · family, foodie, future-of-food
registers.quote: Be selfish. What would get you to the next step. I want to help move you forward.

chips: tools for the partnerships org across Alphabet
grew the Advertiser Community in 10 languages
voice.note: Inference, flagged: I read the storyteller-to-builder arc as the through-line, and consent-first as a value, from your career and one call. Both are reads, not things you said in those words. The facts above are yours; the shape is mine.

altitude.h2: Meet you as the practitioner, climb to the org.
altitude.lede: You move across the whole range fluently, because you have actually sat at each height, and on our call you moved through all of them in one conversation. The read, from that call and your career: meet you as the builder who already proved this, not explain the value back to the person who invented it.

rungs.body: You built the stitching yourself: first and third party data into a brief, with data science before there was AI
rungs.trigger: a concrete mechanism, jobs-to-be-done, the actual data model

rungs.body: You run the twenty-person org that builds the tools for the whole partnerships function
rungs.trigger: how it scales, the portfolio, the roll-up across business units

rungs.body: You brief Sundar-level readers; the Demis pre-meeting brief is your live example
rungs.trigger: the five bullets, the one-way door, what the office of the CEO actually reads

rungs.body: You grew the Advertiser Community in ten languages, and you are native in three. Translating context across regions is literally your background, not a metaphor
rungs.trigger: the same lossless translation this engine runs across altitudes, applied across Google’s regions and languages

altitude.note: Source: this read leans on the forensic recoil of our call, the reverse-listening pass, more than on the resume. The resume gave the arc; the call gave the register.

lands: The real before and after, concrete on our actual call, not the theory
Model-agnostic, runs on Gemini, nothing leaves Google, you own the file
Consent-first, provenance clean, honest about stated versus revealed preference
Agent-loop framing, one human steering, the shape you are building with Agentum
Your own examples reflected back, Sundar and Demis, in your words
loses: Abstract theory or a coherence engine with no concrete output
A pitch or an ask when you have signalled nothing-to-sell
Any story where data leaves Google or a vendor locks you in
Anything that asks you to cross the line on non-public information
Over-pursuit; being pushed rather than invited

evidence.h2: Tuned on two sources, and honest about it.
evidence.lede: Robin’s read had a whole library: site, podcasts, talks, a book. Yours has two sources, and the read says so out loud rather than pretending to more.

sources.p: 15 years at Google, Ads to Cloud to Partnerships, the internal-tools thread
recorded with your OK, the ground truth for every read here
theagentum.com and our LinkedIn exchange, the newest signal

evidence.note: To dial the resolution up: GitHub for what you actually build, X for real-time interests, a personal site or Crunchbase for the investing side. Each independent source raises confidence. Consent-first, only if you want.

quiet_signals.h2: What the surface does not say.
quiet_signals.lede: Anyone can read your resume. These are the deeper tells, computed from the pattern across your own words. This is the engine deriving meaning, not amplifying signal.

cards.headline: You built this five years early, by hand.
cards.body: You automated the Sundar brief with data science before there was AI. Your curiosity is a builder’s, not an admirer’s. You are not evaluating whether the thesis is real; you proved it.
cards.so: Meet you as a peer who lived it. Never explain the value you already shipped.

cards.headline: Lock-in is the thing you design against.
cards.body: Agentum runs on Claude or other LLMs. That is not a spec line, it is a value. A single-vendor story reads to you as a trap.
cards.so: Lead with runs-on-Gemini, nothing leaves Google. That is the deal-maker, not a footnote.

cards.headline: Data ethics sits at the identity level.
cards.body: “You’re doing the right thing.” Your parents read every terms-and-conditions. Consent-first is not a feature to you, it is table stakes.
cards.so: A data-egress story ends the conversation. Provenance-clean and opt-in is the price of entry.

cards.headline: You give intros with no percentage, no ask.
cards.body: Reciprocity is your currency, not equity. You connect people and take nothing, because the value is the connection.
cards.so: Your help is real and freely given. Honor it as a gift; do not try to transact it.

cards.headline: You open the door; you are not pushed through it.
cards.body: “Be selfish, what would get you to the next step.” You invite the next move rather than being sold on it. You gave nothing-to-sell energy and meant it.
cards.so: Let you name the next step. Over-pursuit reads as not listening.

loop.lede: This profile read is step one. The rest of the loop is already built. Every stage points to something you can open.

close: Two registers, one person, read from public signal alone. The whole studio is just this read, applied: meet you as the builder who proved it, in your words, and let you be the one to take it further.
